failure_modes: No permitted edit is shown to act on the pair-kernel or joint-internal-RMS observables, since the executing pointcloud scalar contains no such term.

A region_index or pointcloud_delta_A edit could displace surrounding coordinates and shift the global centroid without changing the diagnostic observables, matching the Analyst's stated discriminating failure condition.
A temporal_teacher_blend or temporal_region_index edit could overfit sign-inconsistent continuous contrasts within the observed support without reducing strong sign conflicts.
Any edit justified by survival or turnover credit would conflate recorded joint-head credit with final affinity benefit, which is unavailable.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's own evidence shows the executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit; observable_definitions scope), so the strongest supported contrasts (pair_kernel_1.5/2.5 at branch_adjusted:86,87,240,241,163,164 and endpoint_effects:9,10,11; joint_internal/innovation RMS at branch_adjusted:228,230,305,307) are diagnostic observables, not terms the registered reward contains. No permitted edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) is shown by the supplied evidence to change those observables in a defensible direction, and the Analyst's own discriminating failure conditions (global centroid shift without pair-kernel or internal-RMS change) are not excluded by the evidence. Global centroid adjusted CIs cross zero (branch_adjusted:77-79,231-233), so no region_index is justified on that basis. Continuous contrasts span only [0.0,0.49] with no accepted polynomial and frequent sign conflicts (continuous_functions; curve_support selects 24 of the audited curves), so a time-conditioned edit is not established as superior to the incumbent constant rule. Decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available), so no edit can be justified as improving final predicted affinity, which is the primary objective. Retaining the incumbent is the defensible choice; the Analyst's hypotheses remain testable but unsupported for an operative edit.
